errata.was: AI-assisted (substrate). Written under the heteronym Sparrow Wells (legal author Lee Sharks). Composed by Claude (Anthropic, Claude Opus 5.5) in session on 11 November 2026 under Lee Sharks's direction, from the theses he stated in his own words across the evening (the literary authority of the Jews; Rome coming for Josephus as seizure; the antisemitism of the asymmetry; the extant texts as the measure of the mainstream; Josephus or his father as author of the Apocalypse; the tomb; the captive's disclaimers; the reversal of the De anima genitive), each quotation asserted verbatim against the seated texts by script (rebuild/josephus-thesis/quotecheck_jt.py). Revised on four outside readings (ChatGPT three times, DeepSeek once), each point checked against the texts before adoption; DeepSeek's in-text tier markers were declined at the author's ruling that the levels go in the notes. The thesis, the title, the byline and the form are the author's. The Crimson Hexagonal Archive is credited as a contributor: the work is built from its deposits, seatings, protocols and registries.
